provenance: Prototype policy mapping to sdn/classes.json and the synthetic healthcare_traffic_profiles.csv catalog. Thresholds are experimental assumptions, not clinical standards.

objectives.source: ITU-T Y.3143 (2024), Appendix I Table I.1 ECG remote-health-monitoring latency/jitter/reliability converted to RTT budget by symmetric-path factor two; ITU-T F.780.4 (2023) §8.5.2 gives a generic telemedicine network loss reference ≤5%. Experimental threshold only, not an alarm-system guarantee

ITU-T Y.3143 (2024), Appendix I Table I.1 ECG/physiological remote-health-monitoring latency/jitter/reliability converted to RTT budget by symmetric-path factor two; ITU-T F.780.4 (2023) §8.5.2 gives a generic telemedicine network loss reference ≤5%. Experimental threshold only

ITU-T Y.3143 (2024), Appendix I Table I.2 remote medical consultation latency/jitter/reliability converted to RTT/jitter budget by symmetric-path factor two; 20 Mbps per direction; ITU-T F.780.4 (2023) §8.5.2 generic telemedicine loss reference ≤5%. Experimental threshold only
No directly applicable numeric EHR transaction objective identified; collect measurements and obtain application owner requirements before assigning a hard target

ITU-T Y.3143 (2024), Appendix I Table I.2 remote image diagnosis lists 50 Mbps in each direction, 80 ms latency, and 20 ms jitter; those interactive diagnosis targets are not applicable as hard requirements to this asynchronous bulk-transfer profile
No directly applicable numeric CCTV/background objective identified; collect measurements and obtain application owner requirements before assigning a hard target
